evidence.method: Independent Chromium tests at 375×812 with 100% and 200% root text, save and discard, long and short changed values. Initial geometry measured before scrolling immediately after click and again after the entrance animation.
evidence.longInitialFocus: All four long reviews focus dialog-title at scrollTop 0, fully visible immediately and after animation. Long inputs were an 80-character unbroken name and a 600-character bio.
evidence.shortSafeFocus: At normal text both short reviews fit and focus visible cancel. Save button bounds 499.5–547.5 within dialog 187.5–624.5; discard button bounds 484.5–532.5 within dialog 202.5–609.5. At enlarged text these short reviews overflow, correctly selecting the fully visible title instead.
evidence.tabReachability: From the long-review title, first Tab reaches cancel and second reaches confirm. Both become fully visible through automatic dialog scrolling in all four cases; no manual scrolling is needed. Background form controls never receive focus during checked traversal. Chromium includes a browser-focus transition represented by BODY before returning to dialog controls.
evidence.escapeRecovery: All eight short/long, normal/enlarged save/discard cases close on Escape, preserve drafts, release the page scroll lock and restore focus to the corresponding save or discard opener.
evidence.preservation: Initial review.json and followup-review.json were not modified.
